title_tag: 美国欠钱、五常内斗、战争也管不了：联合国真的还有存在的必要吗？—— 美国《时代周刊》外刊讲解第1153天
h1: 美国欠钱、五常内斗、战争也管不了：联合国真的还有存在的必要吗？
category: 美国《时代周刊》外刊讲解 第1153天

headline.en_html: Make the U.N. Great Again: — The Uphill Struggle Facing the Next Secretary General
headline.zh: 让联合国重振雄风：下一任秘书长面临的艰难挑战

notes.en: difficult to achieve or requiring great effort and determination
notes.ctx: 艰难的（形容下一任联合国秘书长面临的斗争非常艰巨，需要付出极大努力）
notes.ex1: Winning public trust after the scandal was an uphill battle for the new mayor. 丑闻之后，对这位新市长来说，赢得公众信任是一场艰难的战斗。
notes.ex2: Convincing the board to approve the budget proved to be an uphill task. 说服董事会批准这项预算被证明是一项艰巨的任务。

notes.en: the chief administrative officer of an international organization such as the United Nations
notes.ctx: 秘书长（指联合国这一国际组织的最高行政长官）
notes.ex1: The secretary general called for an emergency meeting to address the escalating crisis. 秘书长呼吁召开紧急会议以应对不断升级的危机。
notes.ex2: As secretary general of the organization, she oversees operations in more than fifty countries. 作为该组织的秘书长，她负责监管五十多个国家的运作。

paragraphs.en_html: It may be both the most <mark class="voc">prestigious</mark> and the most frustrating job in international diplomacy: members of the United Nations are <mark class="voc">weighing</mark> who should <mark class="voc">succeed</mark> António Guterres as Secretary-General when he completes his final term in December. The <mark class="voc">timing</mark> couldn’t be more critical, with U.N.’s fortunes at a historically <mark class="voc">low ebb</mark>. With major powers repeatedly blocking the U.N. from intervening in crises and the U.S. <mark class="voc">rolling back</mark> funding, some predict that whoever succeeds Guterres will simply have to do “less with less” and manage a process of institutional decline.
paragraphs.zh: 这或许是国际外交舞台上最显赫、也最令人心力交瘁的职位。联合国成员国正在权衡：当安东尼奥·古特雷斯于今年12月结束最后一个任期后，究竟由谁接任联合国秘书长。这个时间点再关键不过——联合国的处境已跌至历史低谷。大国屡屡阻挠联合国介入国际危机，美国又不断削减资金支持，因此有人预测，无论谁接替古特雷斯，恐怕都只能在资源更加捉襟见肘的情况下“少花钱、少办事”，尽可能体面地应对这一机构日渐式微的局面。

notes.en: respected and admired, usually because of high quality, success, or social standing
notes.ctx: 声望极高的（形容联合国秘书长一职在国际外交领域享有极高声誉）
notes.ex1: She won a prestigious award for her groundbreaking research in medicine. 她因在医学领域的开创性研究而获得了一项享有盛誉的奖项。
notes.ex2: The university is known for its prestigious law program. 这所大学以其久负盛名的法学项目而闻名。

notes.en: to carefully consider something before making a decision
notes.ctx: 权衡，斟酌（指联合国成员国正在仔细考量下一任秘书长的人选）
notes.ex1: The committee is weighing whether to invest in the new project or focus on existing ones. 委员会正在权衡是投资新项目还是专注于现有项目。
notes.ex2: Before accepting the offer, he weighed the benefits against the potential risks. 在接受这个提议之前，他权衡了收益与潜在风险。

notes.en: to take over a position, title, or office from someone who held it before
notes.ctx: 接替（指接替安东尼奥·古特雷斯担任联合国秘书长一职）
notes.ex1: She will succeed the current director when he retires next year. 现任主任明年退休后，她将接替他的职位。
notes.ex2: Who is expected to succeed him as head of the department? 谁有望接替他成为部门负责人？

notes.en: the selection of a particular moment or period for doing something
notes.ctx: 时机（指此时正值联合国处境艰难之际，这一时间节点尤为关键）
notes.ex1: The timing of the announcement was carefully planned to maximize media coverage. 公告的时机经过精心安排，以最大限度地扩大媒体报道。
notes.ex2: Given the timing of the election, many voters were still undecided. 考虑到选举的时机，许多选民尚未做出决定。

notes.en: a point at which something is at its worst or lowest level
notes.ctx: 低谷（指联合国的命运正处在历史最低点）
notes.ex1: The team's morale was at a low ebb after three consecutive defeats. 连续三场失利后，球队的士气处于低谷。
notes.ex2: Relations between the two countries are at their lowest ebb in decades. 两国关系处于几十年来最低迷的时期。

notes.en: to reduce or reverse something such as funding, prices, or rights to a previous level
notes.ctx: 削减（指美国削减了对联合国的资助）
notes.ex1: The new government promised to roll back taxes on small businesses. 新政府承诺削减对小企业的税收。
notes.ex2: Environmental groups are fighting to prevent the rollback of clean air regulations. 环保组织正在努力阻止清洁空气法规被削弱。

paragraphs.en_html: Yet, at a time when global challenges—wars, <mark class="voc">epidemics</mark>, and climate change—continue to <mark class="voc">proliferate</mark>, there is a <mark class="voc">compelling</mark> case for preserving the U.N. as a space for global deal making. The U.N. is an organization that <mark class="voc">rests on</mark> international cooperation, but the current global moment is one of international competition. A <mark class="voc">shrewd</mark> leader could help states de-escalate conflicts and cooperate on global challenges out of <mark class="voc">necessity</mark>, not idealism.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当战争、流行病和气候变化等全球性挑战不断涌现之际，我们仍有充分理由维护联合国，使其继续充当全球协商与博弈的平台。联合国建立在国际合作的基础之上，而当今世界的主旋律却是国际竞争。一位精明老练的领导者，或许能够推动各国缓和冲突，并促使它们在全球性挑战面前携手合作——不是出于理想主义，而是迫于现实需要。

notes.en: a widespread occurrence of an infectious disease in a community at a particular time
notes.ctx: 流行病（指战争、流行病和气候变化等全球性挑战持续增多）
notes.ex1: The cholera epidemic spread rapidly through the overcrowded refugee camps. 霍乱疫情在过度拥挤的难民营中迅速蔓延。
notes.ex2: Governments around the world took drastic measures to contain the epidemic. 世界各国政府采取了严厉措施来控制疫情。

notes.en: to increase rapidly in number or amount
notes.ctx: 不断增多（指全球性挑战——战争、流行病、气候变化——持续激增）
notes.ex1: Online misinformation has proliferated at an alarming rate in recent years. 近年来，网络虚假信息以惊人的速度激增。
notes.ex2: Small coffee shops have proliferated across the city over the past decade. 过去十年间，小咖啡馆在整座城市遍地开花。

notes.en: convincing or powerful enough to make one believe or act
notes.zh: 令人信服的，有说服力的
notes.ctx: 有力的，令人信服的（指保留联合国作为全球协商平台的理由非常有说服力）
notes.ex1: There is compelling evidence that regular exercise improves mental health. 有令人信服的证据表明，经常锻炼能改善心理健康。
notes.ex2: She made a compelling argument for reforming the education system. 她为改革教育体系提出了令人信服的论点。

notes.en: to be based on or depend on something
notes.ctx: 建立在……基础上（指联合国是一个以国际合作为基础的组织）
notes.ex1: The success of the project rests on the cooperation of all team members. 这个项目的成功依赖于所有团队成员的配合。
notes.ex2: His reputation rests on years of honest and dedicated service. 他的声誉建立在多年诚实敬业的付出之上。

notes.en: having or showing sharp powers of judgment; astute
notes.ctx: 精明的（指一位精明的领导人可以帮助各国缓和冲突、开展合作）
notes.ex1: She is a shrewd negotiator who always knows when to compromise. 她是一位精明的谈判者，总是知道何时该做出让步。
notes.ex2: His shrewd investment decisions saved the company from bankruptcy. 他精明的投资决策使公司免于破产。

notes.en: the state of being unavoidable or indispensable; something that must be done
notes.zh: 必要，必然；迫不得已的事
notes.ctx: 出于必要（指各国出于现实必要性而非理想主义开展合作）
notes.ex1: Cutting costs became a necessity after the company lost its biggest client. 失去最大的客户后，削减成本成为必要之举。
notes.ex2: They cooperated out of necessity rather than genuine trust. 他们合作是出于必要，而非真正的信任。

paragraphs.en_html: Maybe the biggest challenge for the next Secretary-General <mark class="voc">lies inside</mark> the Security Council, the organization’s most powerful body. The five <mark class="voc">permanent</mark>, <mark class="voc">veto</mark> power-<mark class="voc">wielding</mark> members—the United States, China, Russia, Britain, and France—have repeatedly blocked intervention in crises from Ukraine to Myanmar. Russia’s <mark class="voc">invasion</mark> of Ukraine and the U.S. decision to attack Iran suggest that some of the council’s most powerful members no longer <mark class="voc">feel bound by</mark> its guiding principles.
paragraphs.zh: 下一任秘书长面临的最大挑战，或许就在联合国内部最具权力的机构——安全理事会。拥有否决权的五个常任理事国——美国、中国、俄罗斯、英国和法国——已屡次阻碍联合国介入从乌克兰到缅甸的一系列危机。俄罗斯入侵乌克兰，以及美国决定对伊朗发动袭击，都表明安理会中一些最具实力的成员国似乎已不再认为自己必须受其基本原则的约束。

notes.en: to be found or located within something
notes.ctx: 存在于内部（指下一任秘书长面临的最大挑战可能在于安理会内部）
notes.ex1: The real problem lies inside the organization's outdated management structure. 真正的问题存在于该组织过时的管理结构内部。
notes.ex2: The answer lies inside the data we have already collected. 答案就在我们已经收集的数据之中。

notes.en: lasting or intended to last indefinitely without change
notes.ctx: 常任的（指联合国安理会五个拥有否决权的常任理事国）
notes.ex1: She finally secured a permanent position after years of temporary contracts. 经过多年的临时合同后，她终于获得了一个永久职位。
notes.ex2: The museum has a permanent collection of modern art. 该博物馆拥有现代艺术的永久馆藏。

notes.en: the power or right to reject a decision or proposal made by others
notes.ctx: 否决权（指安理会五个常任理事国拥有的否决权）
notes.ex1: The president used his veto to block the bill passed by Congress. 总统行使否决权阻止了国会通过的法案。
notes.ex2: China and Russia exercised their veto against the resolution. 中国和俄罗斯对该决议行使了否决权。

notes.en: to hold and use power, authority, or influence
notes.zh: 行使，运用（权力或影响力）
notes.ctx: 行使，拥有（指拥有否决权的常任理事国）
notes.ex1: The committee wields considerable influence over education policy. 该委员会对教育政策拥有相当大的影响力。
notes.ex2: She wields more power than anyone else in the company. 她在公司里行使的权力比任何人都大。

notes.en: an instance of a country entering another by force with an army
notes.ctx: 入侵（指俄罗斯对乌克兰的入侵）
notes.ex1: The invasion of the country drew widespread international condemnation. 对该国的入侵引起了国际社会的广泛谴责。
notes.ex2: The invasion triggered a massive refugee crisis across the region. 这场入侵在整个地区引发了大规模的难民危机。

notes.en: to feel obligated or required to follow a rule, principle, or agreement
notes.ctx: 感到受约束（指一些最强大的成员国不再感到受安理会指导原则的约束）
notes.ex1: Many employees no longer feel bound by traditional office rules. 许多员工不再感到受传统办公规则的约束。
notes.ex2: Do members still feel bound by the organization's founding principles? 成员们是否仍感到受该组织创始原则的约束？

paragraphs.en_html: If the U.N.’s political situation is its main headache, its financial position is a <mark class="voc">close second</mark>. After the Trump Administration cut off <mark class="voc">the bulk of</mark> U.S. funding in 2025, U.N. officials have been wondering how to pay the bills. The U.S. is supposed to cover about a fifth of the organization’s core costs and a quarter of its <mark class="voc">peacekeeping</mark> budget, but currently owes the U.N. about $4 billion. European governments are also <mark class="voc">scaling back</mark> development and <mark class="voc">humanitarian aid</mark>.
paragraphs.zh: 如果说政治困局是联合国最大的心病，那么财政危机则紧随其后。自特朗普政府于2025年切断美国对联合国的大部分资金支持以来，联合国官员一直在为如何维持机构运转而发愁。按规定，美国应承担联合国约五分之一的核心经费和四分之一的维和预算，但目前拖欠联合国的款项约达40亿美元。与此同时，欧洲各国政府也在削减发展援助和人道主义援助。

notes.en: a very narrow runner-up position; almost as important as the first item mentioned
notes.zh: 紧随其后的第二大问题，不相上下的第二位
notes.ctx: 紧随其后的第二大问题（指联合国的财政状况是其第二大难题）
notes.ex1: After cost, convenience is a close second factor for most consumers. 对大多数消费者来说，便利性是仅次于成本的第二大因素。
notes.ex2: In terms of challenges, the team's lack of experience is a close second to its limited budget. 就挑战而言，团队经验不足是仅次于预算有限的第二大难题。

notes.en: the greater part or majority of something
notes.ctx: 大部分（指特朗普政府切断了美国对联合国的大部分资助）
notes.ex1: The bulk of the work was completed in the first week. 大部分工作在第一周就完成了。
notes.ex2: The bulk of the company's revenue comes from overseas sales. 公司的大部分收入来自海外销售。

notes.en: the activity of maintaining peace, especially by deploying military forces to prevent conflict
notes.ctx: 维和（指联合国的维和预算）
notes.ex1: The country contributed troops to the United Nations peacekeeping mission. 该国向联合国维和任务派遣了部队。
notes.ex2: Peacekeeping operations have become increasingly complex and dangerous. 维和行动已变得越来越复杂和危险。

notes.en: to reduce or increase the size, amount, or extent of something
notes.ctx: 缩减（指欧洲各国政府也在缩减发展和人道主义援助）
notes.ex1: The company decided to scale back its operations in Asia. 该公司决定缩减在亚洲的业务。
notes.ex2: We need to scale back the project to fit the new budget. 我们需要缩减项目规模以适应新的预算。

notes.en: material or logistical assistance provided for humanitarian purposes, typically in response to crises
notes.ctx: 人道主义援助（指欧洲政府正在缩减发展和人道主义援助）
notes.ex1: The organization delivered humanitarian aid to families displaced by the earthquake. 该组织向因地震而流离失所的家庭提供了人道主义援助。
notes.ex2: Humanitarian aid workers face growing risks in conflict zones. 人道主义援助工作者在冲突地区面临越来越大的风险。

paragraphs.en_html: This is a <mark class="voc">markedly</mark> different <mark class="voc">landscape</mark> from the one Guterres encountered in 2017, when U.N. members had just agreed to the Paris climate accord and Sustainable Development Goals, including a pledge to <mark class="voc">eradicate</mark> extreme poverty by 2030. That <mark class="voc">brief</mark> moment of optimism proved <mark class="voc">ephemeral</mark>. Rising tensions among major powers have <mark class="voc">eroded</mark> governments’ trust in one another and their faith in the U.N.’s negotiation-based approach. Increasingly, governments are turning instead to smaller, looser decision-making clubs such as the Group of 7 or the BRICS.
paragraphs.zh: 这与古特雷斯2017年上任时所面对的局面截然不同。当时，联合国成员国刚刚达成《巴黎气候协定》，并通过了可持续发展目标，其中包括到2030年消除极端贫困的承诺。然而，那段短暂的乐观岁月最终只是昙花一现。大国之间日益加剧的紧张关系，不断侵蚀各国政府彼此之间的信任，也削弱了它们对联合国以谈判协商解决问题这一模式的信心。越来越多的国家开始转向规模更小、组织更松散的决策机制，例如七国集团（G7）和金砖国家（BRICS）。

notes.en: in a way that is clearly noticeable or evident
notes.ctx: 显著地（指当下的环境与古特雷斯2017年上任时明显不同）
notes.ex1: The company's performance has improved markedly since the new CEO took over. 新首席执行官上任以来，公司的业绩明显改善。
notes.ex2: Attitudes toward remote work have shifted markedly in recent years. 近年来，人们对远程工作的态度发生了显著转变。

notes.en: the distinctive features of a particular situation, field of activity, or intellectual environment
notes.ctx: 格局，形势（指当下的全球政治形势与2017年相比大不相同）
notes.ex1: The political landscape has changed dramatically since the last election. 自上次选举以来，政治格局发生了巨大变化。
notes.ex2: New technologies are rapidly reshaping the media landscape. 新技术正在迅速重塑媒体格局。

notes.en: to completely destroy or put an end to something
notes.ctx: 消除（指联合国可持续发展目标中承诺到2030年消除极端贫困）
notes.ex1: The campaign aims to eradicate malaria from the region within a decade. 该运动的目标是在十年内从该地区根除疟疾。
notes.ex2: Efforts to eradicate poverty require sustained investment in education and healthcare. 消除贫困的努力需要在教育和医疗方面持续投资。

notes.en: lasting for only a short period of time
notes.ctx: 短暂的（指2017年那段乐观的时期非常短暂）
notes.ex1: There was a brief moment of silence before the announcement was made. 在宣布之前有片刻的沉默。
notes.ex2: The ceasefire brought only a brief period of calm to the region. 停火只给该地区带来了短暂的平静。

notes.en: lasting for a very short time; transitory
notes.ctx: 短暂的，转瞬即逝的（指联合国成员达成巴黎气候协定和可持续发展目标时的乐观情绪很快就消退了）
notes.ex1: Fame in the digital age can be surprisingly ephemeral. 数字时代的名声可能出人意料地短暂。
notes.ex2: The joy of winning the championship proved ephemeral as the team soon disbanded. 夺冠的喜悦转瞬即逝，因为球队很快就解散了。

notes.en: to gradually weaken, damage, or destroy something such as trust, confidence, or power
notes.ctx: 侵蚀，削弱（指大国间日益紧张的局势削弱了政府间的互信）
notes.ex1: Years of broken promises have eroded public confidence in the government. 多年的空头承诺逐渐削弱了公众对政府的信心。
notes.ex2: Constant criticism from management eroded the team's morale. 管理层的不断批评侵蚀了团队的士气。

paragraphs.en_html: Eight candidates are currently <mark class="voc">jostling</mark> to replace Guterres, but the selection process creates its own <mark class="voc">dilemma</mark>. The Security Council’s five veto powers are central to <mark class="voc">vetting</mark> candidates and recommending one to the <mark class="voc">General Assembly</mark>. Anyone who wants to be Secretary-General must avoid <mark class="voc">offending</mark> them. Talking about what is wrong with the world today without <mark class="voc">irritating</mark> at least one of the major powers is quite hard.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，共有八名候选人正在竞逐古特雷斯的职位，但秘书长的遴选机制本身就制造了一个两难困境。安理会五个拥有否决权的常任理事国，在审查候选人并向联合国大会推荐人选的过程中发挥着核心作用。这意味着，任何有志于秘书长之位的人，都必须尽量避免得罪这五个国家。然而，要谈论当今世界究竟出了什么问题，却又不触怒任何一个大国，实在不是一件容易的事。

notes.en: to compete or struggle for something such as a position, advantage, or power
notes.ctx: 争夺（指八位候选人正在竞相争夺联合国秘书长一职）
notes.ex1: Several young executives are jostling for the top position in the company. 几位年轻高管正在争夺公司的最高职位。
notes.ex2: Rival companies are jostling for control of the emerging market. 竞争对手公司正在争夺对这个新兴市场的控制权。

notes.en: a situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives
notes.ctx: 困境（指遴选过程本身就造成了一种两难局面）
notes.ex1: The government faces a dilemma: raise taxes or cut public services. 政府面临两难选择：增税还是削减公共服务。
notes.ex2: She found herself in a dilemma when two close friends offered conflicting advice. 当两位好友给出相互矛盾的建议时，她陷入了两难境地。

notes.en: to examine or evaluate someone or something carefully to determine suitability
notes.ctx: 审核（指安理会五个常任理事国在候选人审查中扮演核心角色）
notes.ex1: All candidates are carefully vetted before being offered an interview. 所有候选人在获得面试机会之前都会被仔细审查。
notes.ex2: The committee vetted every proposal before approving funding. 委员会在批准资助前对每项提案都进行了审核。

notes.en: a group of people gathered together for a common purpose, especially for legislation or decision-making
notes.ctx: 大会（指联合国大会，安理会推荐人选后由大会批准）
notes.ex1: The proposal was approved by a majority vote in the general assembly. 该提案在大会上以多数票通过。
notes.ex2: Representatives from all member states attended the assembly. 来自所有成员国的代表出席了大会。

notes.en: to cause displeasure, anger, or resentment in someone
notes.ctx: 冒犯，得罪（指任何想成为秘书长的人都必须避免冒犯常任理事国）
notes.ex1: He was careful not to offend any of the senior executives during the meeting. 他小心翼翼，不在会议期间冒犯任何高级主管。
notes.ex2: The documentary offended many viewers with its controversial content. 这部纪录片因其有争议的内容冒犯了许多观众。

notes.en: to annoy or provoke someone, often mildly or repeatedly
notes.ctx: 惹恼，激怒（指讨论当今世界的问题而不激怒任何一个大国是相当困难的）
notes.ex1: His constant interruptions began to irritate the other panelists. 他不断的插话开始激怒其他讨论小组成员。
notes.ex2: The new policy irritated many long-time employees. 新政策激怒了许多老员工。

paragraphs.en_html: On the diplomatic <mark class="voc">front</mark>, the <mark class="voc">incoming</mark> leader’s priority will be to demonstrate the ability to <mark class="voc">insert</mark> himself or herself into one or more conflicts, signaling a shift from the Guterres era. Conflict prevention and <mark class="voc">peacemaking</mark> have become crowded fields, with a growing number of middle powers leading peace processes the U.N. might once have <mark class="voc">overseen</mark>. The greater danger is that the U.N. fails to engage in meaningful crisis diplomacy at all, <mark class="voc">cementing</mark> the impression that it is no longer a significant peacemaking force.
paragraphs.zh: 在外交层面，新任秘书长上台后的首要任务，将是证明自己有能力真正介入一场或多场国际冲突，从而展现出与古特雷斯时代不同的姿态。如今，预防冲突与斡旋和平早已成为一片拥挤的外交战场，越来越多的中等强国开始主导和平进程，而这些事务过去或许本应由联合国主持。更大的危险在于，联合国可能彻底无法参与任何真正具有分量的危机外交，从而进一步坐实这样一种印象：它已不再是一支举足轻重的国际和平斡旋力量。

notes.en: a particular area of activity, interest, or conflict
notes.ctx: 方面（指在外交方面，新任领导人的首要任务是……）
notes.ex1: On the economic front, the country has made significant progress. 在经济方面，该国取得了重大进展。
notes.ex2: The government is fighting a war on multiple fronts. 政府正在多条战线上作战。

notes.en: about to take up a position or office; arriving or starting
notes.ctx: 即将上任的（指即将上任的联合国领导人）
notes.ex1: The incoming administration has promised sweeping reforms. 即将上任的政府承诺进行全面改革。
notes.ex2: The incoming director will meet with staff on her first day. 新任主任将在第一天与员工见面。

notes.en: to place or involve oneself into a situation or activity
notes.ctx: 使介入（指新任领导人需要展示自己介入一场或多场冲突的能力）
notes.ex1: The mediator tried to insert himself into the negotiations between the two sides. 调解人试图介入双方的谈判。
notes.ex2: The organization inserted itself into the debate over climate policy. 该组织介入了关于气候政策的辩论。

notes.en: the process of bringing about peace, especially by reconciling adversaries
notes.ctx: 促成和平（指冲突预防与和平调解已成为一个拥挤的领域）
notes.ex1: The former diplomat has decades of experience in peacemaking. 这位前外交官在促成和平方面拥有数十年的经验。
notes.ex2: Traditional peacemaking efforts have struggled to keep up with modern conflicts. 传统的和平调解努力难以应对现代冲突。

notes.en: to watch over and direct a process, activity, or organization
notes.ctx: 监督，主导（指越来越多的中等强国主导联合国可能曾经主导过的和平进程）
notes.ex1: She was appointed to oversee the company's expansion into new markets. 她被任命负责监督公司向新市场的扩张。
notes.ex2: An independent committee will oversee the election process. 一个独立委员会将监督选举过程。

notes.en: to make something stronger or more firmly established
notes.zh: 巩固，强化，使（印象或关系）牢固
notes.ctx: 巩固，坐实（指联合国未能参与有意义的外交行动，会坐实它不再是重要和平调解力量这一印象）
notes.ex1: The victory cemented her reputation as one of the best players in the world. 这场胜利巩固了她作为世界最佳球员之一的声誉。
notes.ex2: The agreement helped cement the alliance between the two nations. 该协议帮助巩固了两国之间的联盟。

paragraphs.en_html: The best approach may be to <mark class="voc">frame the U.N. as</mark> <mark class="voc">a sort of</mark> global risk reduction organization. The pandemic, regional conflicts and new technologies have demonstrated how crises can cause global disruption. The U.N. does not have the power to <mark class="voc">halt</mark> these trends, but it is a space in which governments can discuss risks and explore steps to <mark class="voc">mitigate</mark> them. Its advantage is that it remains a <mark class="voc">neutral</mark> space where different <mark class="voc">blocs</mark> of governments can engage in <mark class="voc">dialogue</mark>.
paragraphs.zh: 或许，最好的办法是重新将联合国定位为一种“全球风险管控机构”。新冠疫情、地区冲突以及新兴技术都已经表明，一场危机完全可能引发全球性的连锁震荡。联合国没有能力阻止这些趋势，但它至少能够提供一个平台，让各国政府共同讨论风险，并探索降低风险的可行之策。联合国真正的优势在于，它仍是一片相对中立的空间，使分属不同阵营的国家依然能够坐下来展开对话。

notes.en: to present or describe something in a particular way to influence how it is perceived
notes.ctx: 将联合国定位为一种全球风险防控组织（指最好的办法可能是将联合国塑造成一个全球风险防控机构）
notes.ex1: The CEO framed the restructuring as an opportunity for growth rather than a setback. 首席执行官将重组定位为增长机遇而非挫折。
notes.ex2: Environmentalists framed the campaign as a fight for future generations. 环保主义者将这场运动定位为为子孙后代而战。

notes.en: a type or kind of something, used when describing something imprecisely
notes.ctx: 某种（指将联合国定位为某种全球风险防控组织）
notes.ex1: The community center serves as a sort of gathering place for local residents. 社区中心充当着某种当地居民聚集场所的角色。
notes.ex2: He became a sort of unofficial advisor to the new government. 他成了新政府某种非官方的顾问。

notes.en: to stop or cause to stop moving, progressing, or operating
notes.ctx: 阻止，遏制（指联合国没有能力阻止这些趋势）
notes.ex1: The government introduced emergency measures to halt the spread of the virus. 政府采取紧急措施阻止病毒传播。
notes.ex2: Nothing could halt the decline of the struggling industry. 没有什么能阻止这个陷入困境的行业继续衰退。

notes.en: to make something less severe, serious, or painful
notes.ctx: 缓解，减轻（指各国可以在联合国这个平台上讨论风险并探索缓解风险的步骤）
notes.ex1: Planting trees can help mitigate the effects of climate change. 植树有助于缓解气候变化的影响。
notes.ex2: The company took steps to mitigate the financial impact of the crisis. 公司采取措施减轻危机对财务的冲击。

notes.en: not supporting or favoring either side in a conflict or disagreement
notes.ctx: 中立的（指联合国作为一个中立空间，不同阵营的政府可以在此展开对话）
notes.ex1: Switzerland has remained neutral in European conflicts for centuries. 几个世纪以来，瑞士在欧洲冲突中一直保持中立。
notes.ex2: A neutral third party was brought in to mediate the dispute. 一位中立的第三方被请来调解争端。

notes.en: a group of countries or parties with shared interests or goals, often acting together
notes.ctx: 阵营，集团（指不同国家集团可以在联合国这一中立空间进行对话）
notes.ex1: The eastern European bloc voted against the proposed trade agreement. 东欧集团投票反对拟议的贸易协定。
notes.ex2: The two main political blocs failed to reach a compromise. 两大政治集团未能达成妥协。

notes.en: formal discussion or negotiation between opposing groups or countries
notes.ctx: 对话（指联合国作为中立空间，不同国家集团可以在此进行对话）
notes.ex1: The two countries resumed dialogue after months of silence. 在数月的沉默之后，两国恢复了对话。
notes.ex2: Diplomats hope the talks will open a dialogue between the rival factions. 外交官们希望会谈能在敌对派系之间开启对话。

paragraphs.en_html: The role of the Secretary-General is perhaps to be both the world’s most <mark class="voc">prominent</mark> event organizer and a sort of political <mark class="voc">therapist</mark> for world leaders. The new leader cannot <mark class="voc">heal</mark> all the world’s divisions, but with courage and political <mark class="voc">acumen</mark>, the Secretary-General can make international disputes a little less <mark class="voc">toxic</mark>. That may be a limited vision of what the U.N., sometimes dubbed the “<mark class="voc">parliament</mark> of man,” is for. But in an era of multiplying dangers and distrust, it is a <mark class="voc">noble</mark> and perhaps essential one.
paragraphs.zh: 从某种意义上说，联合国秘书长既要成为全世界最重要的“会议召集人”，又要充当各国领导人的“政治心理治疗师”。新任秘书长当然无法弥合世界上的所有裂痕，但只要拥有足够的勇气与政治智慧，就有可能让国际争端少一些敌意与戾气。这或许是对联合国使命的一种相对克制的设想——毕竟，联合国有时被誉为“人类的议会”。然而，在一个危险不断滋生、互信日益稀缺的时代，这样的使命依然崇高，而且或许不可或缺。

notes.en: important, well-known, or conspicuous
notes.ctx: 重要的，知名的（指秘书长一职或许既是全世界最知名的活动组织者，又是一种世界领导人的“政治治疗师”）
notes.ex1: She is one of the most prominent scientists in the field of genetics. 她是遗传学领域最著名的科学家之一。
notes.ex2: The statue occupies a prominent position in the city square. 这座雕像矗立在城市广场上显眼的位置。

notes.en: a person who helps others improve their mental or emotional well-being through discussion and guidance
notes.ctx: 治疗师（指秘书长需要像政治治疗师一样帮助世界各国领导人处理分歧）
notes.ex1: He has been seeing a therapist to help manage his anxiety. 他一直在看心理治疗师来帮助控制焦虑。
notes.ex2: The coach acted as both a trainer and a therapist for the young athletes. 教练对年轻运动员来说既是训练师又是心理治疗师。

notes.en: to make or become healthy or whole again; to repair divisions or rifts
notes.ctx: 弥合（指新任领导人无法弥合世界上所有的分歧）
notes.ex1: Time is needed to heal the wounds caused by the civil war. 弥合内战造成的创伤需要时间。
notes.ex2: The two leaders met in an attempt to heal the rift between their countries. 两位领导人会面，试图弥合两国之间的裂痕。

notes.en: the ability to make good judgments and quick decisions, especially in a particular field
notes.ctx: 政治智慧，敏锐（指秘书长凭借勇气和政治智慧，可以让国际争端不再那么剑拔弩张）
notes.ex1: Her business acumen helped turn the struggling startup into a market leader. 她的商业头脑帮助这家举步维艰的初创企业成长为市场领导者。
notes.ex2: The ambassador was known for his diplomatic acumen. 这位大使以敏锐的外交才智而闻名。

notes.en: harmful, poisonous, or extremely negative in a way that damages relationships or environments
notes.zh: 有毒的；极其有害的，恶劣的
notes.ctx: 有害的，恶劣的（指秘书长可以减少国际争端的危害性，让争端不再那么“有毒”）
notes.ex1: The toxic political climate made compromise nearly impossible. 恶劣的政治氛围使妥协几乎成为不可能。
notes.ex2: A toxic work environment drove many talented employees to leave. 有毒的工作环境使许多有才华的员工离开了。

notes.en: a legislative body of government; used figuratively to describe a gathering or institution representing all people
notes.ctx: 议会（指联合国有时被称为“人类议会”）
notes.ex1: The parliament passed a new law on environmental protection. 议会通过了一项关于环境保护的新法律。
notes.ex2: The proposal will be debated in parliament next week. 该提案将于下周在议会进行辩论。

notes.en: having or showing fine personal qualities or high moral principles
notes.ctx: 崇高的（指在一个危险与不信任日益增多的时代，这一愿景虽然有限，却是一项崇高且或许必不可少的使命）
notes.ex1: Fighting for social justice is a noble cause. 为社会正义而战是一项崇高的事业。
notes.ex2: His noble efforts to help the refugees earned him widespread respect. 他帮助难民的崇高努力为他赢得了广泛的尊重。

proper.name: Secretary-General of the United Nations / 联合国秘书长
proper.def:
联合国秘书处的最高行政首长，也是联合国系统的“首席外交官”。任期五年，理论上可连任一次；人选由安理会多轮“意向性投票”筛选后推荐给大会，大会通常以简单多数通过。古特雷斯 2017 年上任，按惯例于 2026 年 12 月 31 日卸任。
本文中的意思：全文的“空缺岗位”。八名候选人争的就是这个位子，而它既要面对五常否决，又要收拾联合国的财政与信誉烂摊子。

proper.name: "Less with less" / “用更少资源做更少事”
proper.def:
对“do more with less（以更少投入做更多产出）”的刻意反转：不再追求效率，而是接受职能萎缩——维和行动从 2015 年的 16 个降至 2025 年的 10 个左右，人道援助配给不足，行政预算冻结。
本文中的意思：作者用它概括下一任秘书长的处境，不再是“改革与发展”，而是“如何体面地管理衰落”。

proper.name: Security Council / 联合国安全理事会（安理会）
proper.def:
联合国六大机构中权力最集中者，依《联合国宪章》第二十四条负“维持国际和平与安全之主要责任”。由 5 个常任理事国与 10 个非常任理事国组成，决议具国际法约束力，可授权制裁、禁运乃至动武。
本文中的意思：下一任秘书长最大的挑战所在——五常一分裂，安理会即陷入瘫痪。

proper.name: Five permanent members (P5) / Veto power / 五常与否决权
proper.def:
美、中、俄、英、法，二战主要战胜国。依《宪章》第二十七条第三款，非程序性决议须至少 9 票赞成且无常任理事国反对，一票即可否决整项决议。苏联（俄罗斯）使用最多，逾 120 次，美国逾 80 次。
本文中的意思：作者说安理会“最具实力的成员已不再受原则约束”，指的正是这套机制被反复动用。

proper.name: Ukraine crisis / 乌克兰危机
proper.def:
2022 年 2 月 24 日俄罗斯对乌克兰发动“特别军事行动”，实为全面入侵，酿成欧洲二战以来最大规模地面战争。联大多次通过决议谴责并要求撤军，安理会却因俄一票否决无法采取强制措施。
本文中的意思：作者举它证明大国自己动武时，联合国束手无策。

proper.name: Myanmar crisis / 缅甸危机
proper.def:
2021 年 2 月 1 日缅甸国防军推翻昂山素季领导的民选政府，宣布进入紧急状态，抗议演变为内战。安理会召开数十次会议，因中俄主张不干涉、西方主张制裁，仅出一份无强制效力的主席声明。
本文中的意思：与乌克兰并列，说明“从乌克兰到缅甸”的干预屡屡被挡。

proper.name: U.S. decision to attack Iran / 美国攻击伊朗的决定
proper.def:
指美国对伊朗核设施、革命卫队海外基地等目标采取的军事打击。行动未事先提交安理会审议，也未获授权，直接违反《宪章》第二条第四款禁止使用武力之原则。
本文中的意思：作者以此说明美国同样绕开联合国自行其是，安理会权威被两头削弱。

proper.name: Trump Administration (2025 funding cut) / 特朗普政府削减联合国经费
proper.def:
特朗普 2025 年 1 月就任第 47 任总统后，以行政命令和国会拨款大幅削减对联合国系统几乎所有机构的资助，涉及 UNDP、UNICEF、UNFPA、WFP、UNRWA；第一任期他已退出联合国人权理事会。
本文中的意思：联合国财政危机的直接起因，也是标题“美国欠钱”的来处。

proper.name: U.S. contribution to U.N. core budget and peacekeeping / 美国摊款比例
proper.def:
联合国经常预算每三年按国民总收入等指标调整，美国常年约占 22%（约五分之一），维和预算约占 27%（约四分之一），均为第一大户。截至 2026 年初，拖欠会费与维和摊款累计约 40 亿美元。
本文中的意思：解释文中“五分之一核心经费、四分之一维和预算”与 40 亿美元欠款的来历。

proper.name: European governments scaling back aid / 欧洲削减发展与人道援助
proper.def:
2020 年代中后期，能源价格高企、制造业外流、难民压力与右翼政党上台，使欧洲多国压缩对外援助：英国将 ODA 占国民总收入比例从 0.7% 降至 0.5%，德国因“债务刹车”削减气候融资，法国减少西非人道项目。
本文中的意思：美国撤资之外的第二重打击，2025 年 OCHA 仅募得所需资金的 40%。

proper.name: Paris climate accord / 《巴黎气候协定》
proper.def:
2015 年 12 月 COP21 通过、2016 年 11 月生效。核心机制是“国家自主贡献”：各国自定减排目标、每五年更新，不设惩罚条款，首次把中美印等主要排放国纳入同一框架。
本文中的意思：古特雷斯 2017 年上任时的“多边主义高光”，与今天的低潮形成对照。

proper.name: Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) / 可持续发展目标
proper.def:
2015 年 9 月由 193 个成员国通过的 17 项全球目标（含 169 项子目标），期限为 2016 至 2030 年，涵盖消除贫困、零饥饿、优质教育、气候行动等。2025 年中期评估显示多数目标严重滞后。
本文中的意思：与《巴黎协定》一起，构成 2017 年那阵短暂乐观的背景。

proper.name: Eradicate extreme poverty by 2030 / 2030 年前消除极端贫困
proper.def:
SDG 目标 1.1 的具体承诺。极端贫困按世界银行标准为每日生活费低于 2.15 美元（2017 年购买力平价）。2015 年约 7.5 亿人，2024 年仍有约 6.5 亿，世行预测 2030 年仍将超过 5 亿。
本文中的意思：作者用它说明当年那点乐观为何“转瞬即逝”。

proper.name: Group of 7 (G7) / 七国集团
proper.def:
1975 年成立的六国集团，加拿大次年加入而成 G7；俄罗斯 1998 年入组为 G8，2014 年因吞并克里米亚被冻结资格。无常设秘书处、无正式条约，每年由轮值主席国办峰会。
本文中的意思：各国弃联合国而去的第一类“更小、更松散的决策俱乐部”。

proper.name: BRICS / 金砖国家
proper.def:
原为高盛经济学家奥尼尔 2001 年提出的投资概念（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国），2010 年南非加入正式成组。2024 年 1 月扩员，吸纳伊朗、埃及、埃塞俄比亚、阿联酋与沙特（沙特暂未最终确认）。
本文中的意思：与 G7 并列，说明决策正流向“利益相近的小群体”，而非 193 国的联合国大会。

proper.name: General Assembly / 联合国大会
proper.def:
由全部 193 个会员国组成、一国一票的审议与代表机构，每年 9 至 12 月举行常会。决议无强制约束力，但有政治与道义分量；任命秘书长时通常只是“形式上的任命机关”。
本文中的意思：安理会推荐人选后由它走程序，实权有限，候选人真正要过的是五常那一关。

proper.name: Vetting candidates / 候选人审查
proper.def:
秘书长遴选并非公开竞选，而是安理会闭门磋商：成员国提名、候选人与安理会“非正式对话”、多轮用颜色区分鼓励与否决的意向性投票；五常任何一国投反对票，候选人即出局。
本文中的意思：正是这套机制逼得候选人不敢批评美国制裁、俄罗斯动武或中国人权记录。

proper.name: Global risk reduction / 全球风险削减
proper.def:
作者为联合国提出的“退而求其次”定位，区别于“冲突解决”与“和平缔造”。源于灾害管理，强调预防胜于应对：早期预警、技术标准协调、信息共享、气候适应基金。现有机制如 WHO《国际卫生条例》、IAEA 核安全通报。
本文中的意思：与其指望它调停战争，不如务实当“全球风险讨论平台”。

proper.name: Neutral space / 中立空间
proper.def:
联合国的独特资产不是军力或财力，而是普遍性会员资格与形式上平等的主权地位。即便美中对抗、美俄关系接近冰点，两国外交官仍能在走廊和闭门磋商中保持最低限度接触。
本文中的意思：作者眼中联合国不可替代的价值——加沙、朝鲜等议题上少数仍能对话的管道。

proper.name: "Parliament of man" / “人类议会”
proper.def:
常被追溯至英国哲学家，最著名的引用出自第二任秘书长哈马舍尔德（1953—1961 在任），他把联合国比作“人类集体良知的表达场所”。但联合国无立法权、无征税权、也无军队。
本文中的意思：文末用它承认理想已不可行，却仍给秘书长留一丝道义高度。

proper.name: Political therapist / 政治治疗师
proper.def:
并非章程规定的职位，而是比喻：秘书长解决不了大国冲突的根源（意识形态、地缘利益、民族主义），却能通过私下沟通、倾听诉求、降低辞令激烈程度，帮领导人管理情绪、减少误判。
本文中的意思：与“会议召集人”并列，是作者给下一任秘书长设想的新角色。

sources_note: 资料核对：本页内容依 2026 年 9 月 1 日课件整理，原文为 TIME 2026 年 8 月 31 日刊发的 《Make the U.N. Great Again: The Uphill Struggle Facing the Next Secretary General》，作者 Richard Gowan、Daniel Forti。会费比例、拖欠数额、维和预算等背景数据参考联合国会费委员会、联合国维和行动部与世界银行公开资料。

practice.intro: 把下面六句翻译成英文，注意划线表达。
items: 说服董事会批准这项预算被证明是一项艰巨的任务。
连续三场失利后，球队的士气处于低谷。
他们合作是出于必要，而非真正的信任。
大部分工作在第一周就完成了。
多年的空头承诺逐渐削弱了公众对政府的信心。
有毒的工作环境使许多有才华的员工离开了。
practice.critical_en: Conflict prevention and peacemaking have become crowded fields, with a growing number of middle powers leading peace processes the U.N. might once have overseen.
practice.critical_zh: 如今，预防冲突与斡旋和平早已成为一片拥挤的外交战场，越来越多的中等强国开始主导和平进程，而这些事务过去或许本应由联合国主持。
practice.answer:
1. Convincing the board to approve the budget proved to be an uphill task.

2. The team's morale was at a low ebb after three consecutive defeats.

3. They cooperated out of necessity rather than genuine trust.

4. The bulk of the work was completed in the first week.

5. Years of broken promises have eroded public confidence in the government.

6. A toxic work environment drove many talented employees to leave.

一句总结：六句都落在今天这篇的六个核心表达上——uphill task、at a low ebb、out of necessity、the bulk of、erode、toxic，套用原文句式即可，不必另换同义词。
